## Summary

ProfiPrompt is a local-first PySide6 desktop app for managing AI prompts, prompt versions, boards, clipboard copy modes, and TXT/PDF/JSON exports. The app stores user data locally as JSON and does not require cloud services or telemetry. Fully supports 6 languages (DE, EN, ES, ZH, JA, RU) under Policy P-006 Tier-2.

## Main interfaces

- Desktop app: `python src/profiprompt.py`
- Windows launcher: `START.bat`
- Library export: `profiprompt-library-v1.json`
- Web/PWA companion: `web_companion/`
- Platform smoke: `python src/platform_smoke.py --output-dir build/platform-smoke`
- Store readiness protocol: `python scripts/check_store_readiness.py write-test-protocol`
- Translation check: `python manage_translations.py --check`

## Audience & Personas

- [PERSONA-1] Prompt Engineers & LLM Practitioners: Prompt version control, iteration history, result tracking, and prompt testing.
- [PERSONA-2] Desktop Power Users & Solo Developers: Local-first productivity, instant multi-mode clipboard, visual kanban boards.
- [PERSONA-3] Privacy-Conscious Enterprise & Compliance Officers: Zero-egress, 100% offline data isolation, GDPR/DSGVO compliance.
- [PERSONA-4] Multi-Device Knowledge Workers & Curators: Portable `profiprompt-library-v1.json` format and mobile Web/PWA companion.

## Data and privacy

- Prompt and board data are local JSON files.
- Default user data lives under the local user profile in `.prompt_manager`.
- The Web/PWA companion is read-only and imports `profiprompt-library-v1.json` directly in the browser.
- No telemetry, cloud sync, analytics, or external API access is part of the app.
- Governed by 10 strict runtime invariants (INV-LOCAL-01 through INV-SLA-10) detailed in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.

## Validation

- Python tests: `python -m pytest` (152 passed, 3 skipped)
- Web/PWA tests: `node --test web_companion/tests/*.test.js web_companion/tests/*.mjs` (40 passed)
- Total test suite: 187 passing tests (100% green)
- Compile smoke: `python -m py_compile src/profiprompt.py src/platform_smoke.py src/pdf_exporter.py manage_translations.py translator.py`
- Store readiness: `python scripts/check_store_readiness.py` and `python scripts/check_store_readiness.py write-test-protocol`

## Scope boundaries

- ProfiPrompt is a prompt-library and prompt-workflow tool, not an AI model runtime.
- The Web/PWA companion is for reading, searching, copying, and offline browsing exported prompt libraries; the desktop app remains the writer/editor.
- Future sync or cloud features should be explicit opt-in features and must preserve the local-first privacy model.
